title: John Lear: a billion aliens live in the mountains by a highway

tellings.quote: he used to tell me there were aliens living in the mountains

plain: In the 1980s, a man named John Lear claimed that aliens were living inside the mountains along a highway, a billion of them going by how the story is titled. A man named Bob Lazar, who knew Lear, repeats it on the show: "he used to tell me there were aliens living in the mountains." If it were true, a huge hidden population would be living right beside an ordinary road.
